name: developer-portfolio
title: Developer Portfolio
description: A developer portfolio template fusing three portfolios: three-column layout with dashed rails, bracketed section titles in the left column and a sticky right index with search, theme and what you are building. Cover and avatar hero with bullet intro, featured X/community cards, icon info rows and live local time; skills marquee; dotted experience timeline with Active/Done pills; wide project cards; achievements; flat GitHub graph; blog with summaries; light/dark theme and Ctrl+K search. All content comes from one typed data prop.
